spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-VAL-003] ARGUS VISUAL PROOF (HBR-VIS). Every GUI/operator-surface/diagnostic-surface/frontend Studio change MUST be inspected and (where steered) verified through Argus with stable `author_id` targets, before/after observation, and recorded evidence; missing Argus visibility/steering is HBR-VIS debt with allowed same-MT/WP remediation.

[STU-MDL-004] STEERABILITY IS COMMAND-API-FIRST. A model steers Studio through the canonical command API first; it MUST NOT use OS-level input injection. For GUI proof and steering, Argus drives the AccessKit-visible controls by `author_id` (`argus.inspect`/`argus.click`/`argus.set_value`/`argus.screenshot`) per `.GOV/roles_shared/docs/ARGUS_VISUAL_INSPECTION_PROTOCOL.md`. Both paths (command API for authority mutation; Argus for visual verification/steering) resolve to the same `StudioDocument` authority through the promotion lifecycle (14.18).

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.

For GUI proof and steering, Argus drives the AccessKit-visible controls by `author_id` (`argus.inspect`/`argus.click`/`argus.set_value`/`argus.screenshot`) per `.GOV/roles_shared/docs/ARGUS_VISUAL_INSPECTION_PROTOCOL.md`. Both paths (command API for authority mutation; Argus for visual verification/steering) resolve to the same `StudioDocument` authority through the promotion lifecycle (14.18).

inputs.owning_semantics: Headless single-document operation orchestration, provider registration and test ports. Multi-output delivery captures immutable revision/presets/output verification and uses existing Job Runtime via a port for queue/watchfolder/cancel/retry, without a second job database or queue authority. No built-in all-engine mega dependency.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.
